storylines.Scottie Scheffler: The undisputed best player in the world has won 10 of his last 52 starts — it's Scottie vs. the field these days, reminiscent of Tiger in 2000. Back-to-back top-10s at Pebble (T6 in 2024, T9 in 2025) and the best SG Total in the field (+3.06) make him the clear favorite. When Scheffler tees it up, the question isn't if he'll contend, but whether anyone can keep up.
